chapters.title: 1. DECK THE (DORM) HALLS. It’s 1992 when we first meet best friends, Sugar and Booze, who are throwing a cozy holiday party in their dorm room complete with the musical stylings of Sugar’s living legend of a relative, Auntie Ana.

2. SLEIGH RIDE TO THE FUTURE. In a flash-forward to 2018, Sugar and Booze are adults with husbands and children but, for some reason, their close bond of friendship has dissolved over the years. What could have happened?
3. POP A CORK, PUT ON THOSE DANCING SHOES. Back in the early 2000s, Sugar and Booze throw their yearly holiday fete, complete with their close friends, new friends, spouses, and a maw of children.
4. MIXING NAUGHTY WITH THAT NICE. At Booze’s holiday party of 2009, a couple moments arise that seem to break the holiday cheer, casting the future of these friends into unknown waters.

5. IT’LL BE A BLUE BLACK FRIDAY. As heard through the annual holiday letters between 2010-2019, Sugar and Booze’s relationship grows more and more distant as their lives change and grow with their families and homes in different states.
6. HARD (CBD) CHRISTMAS. In a moment of crisis, Booze receives a bit of holiday enlightenment from an unexpected visitor.

7. POUR A NIP INTO THAT NOG. It’s 2019, and Booze decides to throw her annual holiday party, reaching out to Sugar in hopes of rekindling their friendship. Friends far and wide come to join the fun, but get treated to an unexpected holiday spectacle.
8. AND A HAPPY NEW YEAR! Sugar, Booze, and the rest of their friends and family share their annual holiday letters and well wishes for 2019.
